messages:
Anya Patel: Heads-up — we need to lock the newsletter cadence and the launch email for the benchmark webinar next Wednesday. Can we decide cohort splits + send windows today?
Matt Chen: For cohorts I propose: 1) Product trial users, 2) Eng/ML subscribers, 3) Enterprise/account holders. Keep the creative similar but tweak CTAs per cohort.
Sophie Alvarez: Subject options: A) 'How top teams cut inference cost by 3x — webinar' B) 'Benchmark results: real latency & cost wins' C) 'Benchmark webinar: reduce LLM serving cost' — vote? :ballot_box_with_check: 
Eli Rosen: Vote B (more concrete). Recommend enterprise subject variant that emphasizes SLA/scale and drops the word 'webinar'.
Anya Patel: +1 B for broad list. Separate enterprise variant. Send windows? Primary NA/EMEA.
Matt Chen: Staggered sends: NA Wed 10am PT, EMEA Wed 10am GMT, APAC Thu 10am SGT. Aligns with local mornings and avoids overnight sends.
Sophie Alvarez: For the invite drip: initial invite, reminder (48h), last-chance (3h). Follow-up: recording + TL;DR + CTA to book demo. Keep messaging short and benefit-first.
Eli Rosen: Inbound routing: clicks from enterprise cohort should land in HubSpot list 'Bench-Webinar-Enterprise' and trigger SDR sequence. Non-enterprise clicks -> nurture drip and product plays. Use firmographic rules: company_size > 250 OR tag == 'enterprise'.
Marcom Bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/bench-webinar-draft — draft copy attached.
Anya Patel: Sophie, can you draft the first email copy with two CTAs: primary 'Register' and secondary 'See benchmark snapshot'? Put hero stat at the top.
Sophie Alvarez: Will do. Plan: hero stat, three bullets (latency, cost, regression-free), speaker line, CTA. Short paragraphs.
Matt Chen: A/B test subject lines A vs B, and test CTA color (blue vs emerald) for Eng cohort. Aim for ~10k per variant for statistical power.
Eli Rosen: Tracking: use UTM template: ?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1&utm_content={cohort}_{variant}. Optionally set utm_term for subject variant.
Sophie Alvarez: I'll add the UTM to every button and link, plus a hidden input so HubSpot captures cohort on click.
Anya Patel: Metrics to watch first 48h: delivery rate, open rate, CTR, registration conversion, and demo bookings. Set dashboard to compare cohorts and variants side-by-side.
Matt Chen: I'll mock dashboard tiles. Also surface cost per registration and CPL for SDR justification.
Eli Rosen: SDR handoff: increment lead score for registrants and for watched >50% of recording. Follow-up cadence: 1) thank-you email 24h, 2) tailored case study at 3 days, 3) book-demo nudge at 7 days.
Sophie Alvarez: Draft subject variants + first-email copy by EOD, pushing to content doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-webinar-copy — comment when ready.
Anya Patel: Final asks: Sophie deliver copy + alt subject lines; Matt set up A/B test config & dashboard; Eli confirm HubSpot routing + SDR flow. Quick sync at 4pm PT to sign off.
Matt Chen: On it. I'll add localized subject variants for EMEA (metric formatting & timezone).
Eli Rosen: Also propose a short in-email GIF showing 2x latency improvement for execs. Keep file <500KB.
Sophie Alvarez: Good idea — I'll make a compact GIF and include it as progressive enhancement.
Marcom Bot: Reminder set for 4:00 PM PT sign-off meeting. :alarm_clock:
Anya Patel: Thanks team — if no blockers we'll ship the Eng cohort invite tomorrow morning and the broader list after QA.
Matt Chen: Minor note — ensure landing page variant for enterprise has a button to request an SLA discussion; different hidden field for SDR routing.
Sophie Alvarez: Uploading draft email and GIF to the content doc now.
Eli Rosen: Confirmed — I'll publish the SDR playbook and ping the reps.
Anya Patel: See you at 4pm.
